name: Archimedes
description: Turns a natural-language investment intent into a research-grounded, rigor-gated portfolio strategy on Arc public testnet (chain ID 5042002). Generation is not anchored on-chain. Simulated paper deployments are live: paper_daily_returns is the graded track record the rigor gate sees. paper_agent_trades (PR #1704, not on main) is not a live path. Neither is on-chain execution proof. Executing strategies in non-custodial USDC vaults on Arc is roadmap, not shipped.

erc8004.note: Not registered on-chain: no register() transaction has been confirmed for this deployment's wallet, so agentId and tokenURI are null and NO ERC-8004 identity, reputation, or validation claim is made. Publishing a spec-typed registration file at registrationUri is not the same as being registered. This status is re-derived from a live registry read on every request; the sibling erc8004_verification block says which reading produced it. Plan the call with scripts/register_erc8004_identity.py --plan.

authentication.description: Use /api/auth/* and retain session cookie. Optional EIP-4361 wallet proof uses /api/wallets/* and never creates a session.

endpoints._note: Paths are relative to service.endpoint's origin. The /api/auth/* group is served by the Better Auth service behind the same origin, not by the REST API, so it does not appear in /openapi.json. Every other path here is asserted against the API's OpenAPI document in CI.

generate.note: quote is public — price the run before holding a session, and it is the authority on whether the run costs money. On the deployment that serves this card it answers payment_required: true, dry_run: false, price "$2.000000" USDC (read 2026-08-30): start really charges. Unlinked wallet → 409 wallet_link_required; linked but no Payment-Signature → 402 carrying the x402 requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, which you sign (x402 / Circle Gateway) and retry. The code DEFAULTS are the opposite (GENERATION_PAYMENT_REQUIRED off, PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN on), so read the quote against the host you are calling rather than assuming either state.

account.note: Today's generation usage against both daily caps, plus the live price quote. Backs the CLI's `meter`.

rigor.note: Runs the gate's admission checks over a bare returns series you submit. DSR and walk-forward OOS are evaluable; PBO and the look-ahead audit report not_evaluable rather than a silent pass. `passes` is a QUORUM over the two runnable legs -- true only when DSR and OOS both ran and passed -- and because PBO and look-ahead can never run here the verdict is CAPPED, not equivalent to the strategy passport gate. Read legs_evaluated / legs_runnable / legs_total / verdict_capped alongside it. Minimum evaluation window is 250 daily bars (one trading year): under it the route answers 422 with reason window_too_short and bars_received/bars_required, never a verdict. Dates must be strict YYYY-MM-DD, unique and ascending; returns finite with |r| <= 1.0. Backs the CLI's `verify`. Rate limited 5/minute.

paper.note: Simulated paper deployments (POST /api/paper/deployments) are live: no chain, no funds. status live names that path. The graded book is paper_daily_returns — the track record the rigor gate sees, not on-chain execution proof. paper_agent_trades is an executor ledger / signal-state index from PR #1704 and is not on main; it is not what this group advertises. Do not round this up into paper trading validating a vault — vault execution is roadmap, not shipped. The deploy group's route resolves, but putting a strategy into an on-chain vault is roadmap, not shipped, and no user vault has ever been created. Arc is a testnet whose USDC comes from a faucet in any case.

deploy.note: The deploy-a-vault journey is roadmap, not shipped: it is gated off every shipped surface (the UI's ROADMAP_SURFACES_ENABLED build flag, off by default) and no user vault has ever been created. `status: "roadmap"` above describes reachability for a user, not whether the route string 404s — the path resolves and the contracts behind it are deployed, but do not tell anyone Archimedes executes strategies on-chain today. The roadmap shape is non-custodial: when it ships, the caller's linked wallet will own the vault and the agent will hold rebalance authority only, never withdraw-to-platform.

marketplace.note: Marketplace is not a public surface. `status: "roadmap"` means do not present publish/subscribe as a shipped journey. The route strings exist and are wired, but they are not a product a visitor can use. This card also does not assert that a subscription's recurring USDC charge settles for real — that rides PAYMENTS_DRY_RUN, a DIFFERENT switch from the one the generation paywall reports.

monitor.note: Monitoring a live position is roadmap, not shipped: `GET /api/vaults/{address}/health` resolves, but no user vault has ever been created, so there is no live position of a user's to read.

skills.name: Generate strategy
skills.description: Turn a natural-language investment intent into a rigor-gated portfolio strategy (DSR / PBO / walk-forward OOS), grounded in the quantitative-finance research corpus.

skills.name: Paper trade
skills.description: Simulated paper deployments (POST /api/paper/deployments) are live. The graded book is paper_daily_returns; it is not on-chain execution proof. paper_agent_trades (PR #1704) is not on main and is not this skill. Vault execution is roadmap, not shipped.

skills.name: Deploy vault (roadmap)
skills.description: Executing a rigor-passing strategy in a non-custodial USDC vault on Arc is roadmap, not shipped. `POST /api/vaults/create` resolves and the contracts behind it are deployed, but the journey is roadmap-gated off every shipped surface and no user vault has ever been created.

skills.name: Monitor a live position (roadmap)
skills.description: `GET /api/vaults/{address}/health` is live and answers for any address given to it, but with no user vault ever created there is no live position of a user's to read — so monitoring one is roadmap, not shipped.

skills.name: Publish (roadmap)
skills.description: Publishing a strategy to a nanopayment marketplace is roadmap, not shipped. Marketplace is not a public surface.

skills.name: Subscribe (roadmap)
skills.description: Subscribing to a published strategy via sub-cent USDC nanopayments is roadmap, not shipped. Marketplace is not a public surface.
